title: CAMERAS tile: live grid, snapshot, add and remove, per-person access (manual until automated)

clauses.text: The CAMERAS tile (Web & Media, not for guests) shows the views in a grid, with each camera's name and state in words.

steps.do: Sign in as a person who is not a guest, open the CAMERAS tile and look at the grid.
steps.expect: Each view has the camera's name and a state word such as live, connecting, lost with the reason, in use, needs password or needs video add-on.

clauses.text: A click or Enter on a view enlarges it.

steps.do: Click a view, or select it and press Enter.
steps.expect: The view enlarges to a bigger picture.

clauses.text: The snapshot button or key saves one JPEG in Pictures and says where.

steps.do: Press the Snapshot button (or its key) on a live view.
steps.expect: A message says the snapshot is saved and gives its path in Pictures. The file opens as a picture.

clauses.text: Cameras can be added, edited and removed, and removing asks first.

steps.do: Add a camera with its address and password, edit it, then remove it.
steps.expect: Add saves it and the password is not shown back. The edit form shows the clean address and never the password. Remove asks for confirmation first.

clauses.text: The computer's own USB camera closes when the tile leaves the screen by Esc, Home, F11, another tile, a view switch, the lock or sign-out.

steps.do: Open the CAMERAS tile with this computer's own USB camera in a view. Leave by Esc, open it again and leave by Home, then again and leave by F11, then open another tile.
steps.expect: The camera's light goes out each time the tile is left. Say what you see (the light going out is still to be confirmed on the Lenovo).

clauses.text: A red band shows whenever this computer's own USB camera is on the screen.

steps.do: Put this computer's USB camera in a view.
steps.expect: A red band shows. It goes when the camera leaves the screen.

clauses.text: Each person sees only the cameras allowed to them.

steps.do: Sign in as a second person who is on no camera's list (needs a second account).
steps.expect: That person sees no camera they were not given.
